author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a full front pin with round head, pinched neck, full belly and flat foot, flanked by two rear pins whose heads and outer flanks curve out from behind it; symmetric about x=24 and no pinched interiors.
omissions: The rear pins' inner flanks and the inner edge of their heads are hidden behind the front pin (as in the source, where their inner contours stop). The earlier collar stripes were dropped because they made the pins read as capsules.
drawing_plan: One mirrored pin profile per pin; front pin on x=24, rear pins on x=12/36 raised 8 units and drawn as outer silhouettes only.
lucide_reference: No bowling-pin glyph in Lucide; the vertical-tangent cubic shoulders follow Lucide flask/bottle construction.
